features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose lower-half dialect control in value input, vector branch conditions rejected as CFG, memref block arguments, memref successor operands, raw scf.index_switch before upstream canonicalization, scf.parallel/scf.forall/scf.reduce staged, and raw scf at the verified VC4Kernel boundary
features.verification: dialect-family check admits restricted scf/cf; Phase 8 verifier checks scalar-i1 cf.cond_br conditions and scalar-i32 cf.switch flags, accepts scf.while as surface-admissible before scf-to-cf, and rejects memref CFG block/successor operands
features.summary: Phase 8 is a value-layer control-flow phase: cf.br, scalar-i1 cf.cond_br, scalar-i32 cf.switch, block arguments, nested structured CF after upstream scf-to-cf, and multi-exit reducible loops are accepted executable static forms before hardware isolation.
features.notes: PHASE8R_CF_COMPLETENESS_SCOPE=ACTIVE. SCF_WHILE_VALUE_TARGET=SUPPORT_NOW. NESTED_STRUCTURED_CF_VALUE_TARGET=SUPPORT_NOW. TL_RANGE_STYLE_LOOP_SKELETON_VALUE_TARGET=SUPPORT_NOW. PERSISTENT_LOOP_SKELETON_VALUE_TARGET=SUPPORT_NOW. PHASE8R_CF_SWITCH_INDEX_SWITCH_POLICY=LOCKED. PHASE8R_MULTI_EXIT_REDUCIBLE_LOOP_POLICY=LOCKED. VECTOR_BRANCH_CONDITION_POLICY=DETERMINISTIC_REJECT_AS_CFG_USE_MASKS. PHASE8R_IRREDUCIBLE_CFG_POLICY=PROBED_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TRITON. IRREDUCIBLE_CFG_POLICY=PROBE_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_SANE_TRITON. Executable value-to-VC4Kernel lowering consumes cf, not raw scf. Upstream scf-to-cf canonicalization is the preferred boundary. QPU control flow is scalar/coherent; vector branch conditions are rejected as CFG and use masks/selects. The tl.range-style loop skeleton and persistent-loop skeleton are value-level targets. irreducible CFG is probe/classify only. TTIR control flow is staged_future_ttir_import and not Phase 8. READY_FOR_TRITON remains NO.
